title: DdDesignReport template
description: A report template as the designer saves it and ddreport renders it to PDF, HTML, XLSX, XLS or CSV. All sizes are in points (1/72 inch); A4 is 595 x 842. Text may contain placeholders: {{field}}, {{customer.name}}, {{page}}, {{pages}}, {{now:dd/MM/yyyy}}, {{sum(price)}}, {{avg(f)}}, {{min(f)}}, {{max(f)}}, {{count()}}, {{qty * price:2}} (:N = N decimals with thousands separators), {{date:dd MMMM yyyy}}, {{if(paid, 'PAID', 'DUE')}}, {{upper(name)}}, {{lower(name)}}, {{round(x, 2)}}, {{terbilang(total)}} (number in Indonesian words), {{index}} (row number). Aggregates run over the group in group and detail bands, over all rows elsewhere.

dataKey.description: Key of the row list in the data; default "rows". The data may also be the row list itself.

sortBy.description: Row fields to sort by, "-" for descending: "category, -total".

groupBy.description: Up to six row fields, "region, city, store"; rows with the same value form a group, printed between groupHeader/groupFooter (groupHeader2/3 for the deeper levels).

pdfA.description: pdf: PDF/A-2b, for archiving: every font embedded (Helvetica, Times and Courier print as the bundled Roboto and Lora), colours in sRGB, and the metadata archives ask for.

groupPageBreak.description: Every group starts on a new page.

thousands.description: Thousands separator of {{x:N}}; default ",". "none" for none.

decimal.description: Decimal separator of {{x:N}}; default ".". Indonesian: thousands "." and decimal ",".

locale.description: "id" for Indonesian month and day names in dates.

csvSeparator.description: CSV separator; default ",". ";" for Excel in Indonesian or European settings.

sheetPerGroup.description: XLSX and XLS: a worksheet for each group of the first groupBy field.

bands.description: The horizontal strips of the report.

columnHeader.description: Under the header on every page: column titles.

groupHeader.description: Before each group (once before all rows without groupBy); repeated at the top of a page its group continues on.

groupFooter.description: After each group: subtotals such as {{sum(total)}}.

summary.description: Once after the last row: grand totals.

color.description: #rrggbb, empty for none, or an expression worked out per row: {{if(total < 0, '#dc2626', '#000000')}}.

margin.description: All four sides, unless set per side.

backgroundImage.description: PNG, JPEG or GIF data URI stretched over the page: letterhead, watermark.

pages.description: header, columnHeader, footer: only on the first page, or (footer) the last.

newPage.description: groupHeader, detail, groupFooter, summary: start on a new page.

colSpan.description: Merge with the cells to the right.

x.description: From the band's left edge, in points.

y.description: From the band's top edge, in points.

text.description: text: the text with placeholders; <b>, <i> and <u> style parts of it. barcode: its content.

showIf.description: Condition such as paid = 'yes' or total > 0; when false the element is not printed. Operators = != < > <= >=, and, or, not.

font.description: Helvetica (default), Times, Courier, or a bundled font: Roboto, Open Sans, Lato, Montserrat, Lora, Playfair Display, Great Vibes.

lineHeight.description: Multiple of the font size, default 1.2.

grow.description: text, table: wrap and let the band grow instead of clipping.

color.description: Text colour; for rect, line, barcode, chart and the lines of a table, the stroke colour.

src.description: image: PNG, JPEG or GIF data URI, or a placeholder such as {{photo}} whose value is one.

slope.description: line: down from top left to bottom right, up from bottom left to top right; otherwise flat or upright by its shape.

showText.description: barcode: print its text under it.

label.description: chart: row field for the categories.

value.description: chart: row field or expression (qty * price), summed per label.

cells.description: table: cell texts, row by row; placeholders allowed.

padding.description: table: room around a cell's text in points; default 3 across and 2 down.

header.description: table: the first row is a bold header row, repeated on every page the table continues on.

footer.description: table: the last row is a bold total row.

stripe.description: table: background of every second body row.

grid.description: table: which lines the border draws.

headerLine.description: table: heavier line under the header row, in points.

footerLine.description: table: heavier line over the total row, in points.

frame.description: table: heavier line around the table, in points.

cellStyle.description: table: the look and merging of single cells, keyed "row,column" from 0.

data.description: table: a list in the data (items); the rows between header and total row repeat per item, where {{field}} is the item's and {{index}} its number. subreport: the list it prints for.

report.description: subreport: the template printed for each item of data, inside the element's box (no footer band).

rowField.description: crosstab: a row for each value of this field.

columnField.description: crosstab: a column for each value of this field.

measure.description: crosstab: what each cell shows, over the rows with its row and column values: an aggregate with an optional format, such as "sum(qty * price):2" or "count()" (the default).

totalLabel.description: crosstab: the label of the total row and column, default "Total".
